## What & why

<!-- What does this change, and why? Call out any change to an existing binding. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `fix` — bug in existing behavior (patch)
- [ ] `feat` — new binding/capability (minor)
- [ ] **breaking** — changes or removes an existing binding (major)
- [ ] `docs` / `refactor` / `chore` — no version impact

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title is a valid [Conventional Commit](https://www.conventionalcommits.org)
- [ ] Tested in a live tmux session
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` if user-facing
